from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityAdmissions(BaseModel):
    """Enrollment and admission statistics for a single university found in one document."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    applicants: int | None = Field(description="Total number of first-time, first-year applicants")
    admitted: int | None = Field(description="Total number of students admitted")
    enrolled: int | None = Field(description="Total number of students enrolled")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityAdmissions]
